lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a grid-like horizontal distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a discernible matrix of light-valued nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal linear features are visible across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the superior edge and lower-luminance shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density constellation of small, high-luminance spots distributed across its visible surface.
